exposure: Prophylactic low-dose paracetamol administration for ductal closure
cohort: The study included very preterm infants born before 32 gestational weeks who either received prophylactic low-dose paracetamol for ductal closure or did not.
finding: The study found no impairment of psychomotor and mental outcome at 12 and 24 months corrected age in very preterm infants after prophylactic low-dose paracetamol administration.
